sentences.text: Easy Virtue is a 2008 British romantic comedy film based on Noël Coward 's play of the same name .	Easy Virtue	Easy Virtue (1928 film)	Noël Coward	Noël Coward	romantic comedy film	romantic comedy film	play of the same name	Easy Virtue (play)
The play was previously made into the silent movie Easy Virtue -LRB- 1928 -RRB- by Alfred Hitchcock .	Easy Virtue	Easy Virtue (1928 film)	Alfred Hitchcock	Alfred Hitchcock

This adaptation is directed by Stephan Elliott , written by Elliott and Sheridan Jobbins , and stars Jessica Biel , Ben Barnes , Colin Firth and Kristin Scott Thomas .	Stephan Elliott	Stephan Elliott	Sheridan Jobbins	Sheridan Jobbins	Jessica Biel	Jessica Biel	Colin Firth	Colin Firth	Kristin Scott Thomas	Kristin Scott Thomas	Ben Barnes	Ben Barnes (actor)
The score contains many Coward and jazz-age songs , some of which are sung or partially sung by the cast .
Easy Virtue is a social comedy in which a glamorous American widow , Larita , impetuously marries a young Englishman , John Whittaker , in the South of France .	Easy Virtue	Easy Virtue (1928 film)
When they return to England to meet his parents , his mother takes an immediate and strong dislike to the new daughter-in-law , while his father , Jim , finds a kindred spirit .

The film was screened at the Toronto International Film Festival and London Film Festival prior to its 7 November release by Pathé in the UK .	Pathé	Pathé	Toronto International Film Festival	Toronto International Film Festival	London Film Festival	London Film Festival	UK	UK
Subsequently , the film was also screened at the Rio International Film Festival , Middle East International Film Festival in Abu Dhabi , and the Rome Film Festival .
It closed the Adelaide Film Festival prior to the Australian theatrical release on 12 March 2009 .	Adelaide Film Festival	Adelaide Film Festival
In May 2009 it was released in the US .
In the United States , the film enjoyed some commercial success .	United States	United States

Sony Pictures Classics paid an estimated $ US1 million to acquire the film 's distribution rights in the United States , Latin America and South Africa .	Sony Pictures Classics	Sony Pictures Classics	United States	United States
The film went on to gross $ US2 .5 million in limited theatrical release in the United States .	United States	United States
